using Raw = std::string
class Refusal : public std::runtime_error
  const char* word
  std::size_t offset
enum class CommandClass {Read, Reveal, Propose, Edit, Commit, Destroy, Spend, Send}
inline constexpr std::string_view wire_name(CommandClass value)
inline std::optional<CommandClass> parse_command_class(std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator==(CommandClass value, std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator!=(CommandClass value, std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator==(std::string_view name, CommandClass value)
inline constexpr bool operator!=(std::string_view name, CommandClass value)
inline const std::vector<std::string> kCommandClassNames
enum class CommandOutcome {Applied, Proposed, Accepted, Conflict, Stale, Invalid, Unsupported, Forbidden, NotPermitted, Refused, Exhausted, NotFound, Unknown, Unavailable, Failed}
inline constexpr std::string_view wire_name(CommandOutcome value)
inline std::optional<CommandOutcome> parse_command_outcome(std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator==(CommandOutcome value, std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator!=(CommandOutcome value, std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator==(std::string_view name, CommandOutcome value)
inline constexpr bool operator!=(std::string_view name, CommandOutcome value)
inline const std::vector<std::string> kCommandOutcomeNames
enum class ReadingOutcome {Page, Gap, Conflict, Stale, Invalid, Unsupported, NotPermitted, Refused, Exhausted, NotFound, Unavailable}
inline constexpr std::string_view wire_name(ReadingOutcome value)
inline std::optional<ReadingOutcome> parse_reading_outcome(std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator==(ReadingOutcome value, std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator!=(ReadingOutcome value, std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator==(std::string_view name, ReadingOutcome value)
inline constexpr bool operator!=(std::string_view name, ReadingOutcome value)
inline const std::vector<std::string> kReadingOutcomeNames
enum class FieldRole {Ordinary, Derived, Ephemeral, Secret}
inline constexpr std::string_view wire_name(FieldRole value)
inline std::optional<FieldRole> parse_field_role(std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator==(FieldRole value, std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator!=(FieldRole value, std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator==(std::string_view name, FieldRole value)
inline constexpr bool operator!=(std::string_view name, FieldRole value)
inline const std::vector<std::string> kFieldRoleNames
enum class CollectionOp {Add, Remove, Move, Replace, Reset}
inline constexpr std::string_view wire_name(CollectionOp value)
inline std::optional<CollectionOp> parse_collection_op(std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator==(CollectionOp value, std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator!=(CollectionOp value, std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator==(std::string_view name, CollectionOp value)
inline constexpr bool operator!=(std::string_view name, CollectionOp value)
inline const std::vector<std::string> kCollectionOpNames
enum class InvokeMode {Propose, Apply}
inline constexpr std::string_view wire_name(InvokeMode value)
inline std::optional<InvokeMode> parse_invoke_mode(std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator==(InvokeMode value, std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator!=(InvokeMode value, std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator==(std::string_view name, InvokeMode value)
inline constexpr bool operator!=(std::string_view name, InvokeMode value)
inline const std::vector<std::string> kInvokeModeNames
inline const std::vector<std::string> kRevealStyleNames
inline constexpr std::string_view kRevealStyleHighlight
inline constexpr std::string_view kRevealStyleScrollTo
inline constexpr std::string_view kRevealStyleFrame
inline const std::vector<std::string> kOpenHandleStateNames
inline constexpr std::string_view kOpenHandleStatePending
inline constexpr std::string_view kOpenHandleStateOpened
inline constexpr std::string_view kOpenHandleStateExpired
inline constexpr std::string_view kOpenHandleStateRefused

inline const std::vector<std::string> kExtensions

inline const std::vector<std::string> kGatewayTools

struct ContextRef
  std::string instance
  std::string context
  std::string epoch
struct ContextEntry
  ContextRef context
  std::string title
  std::string revision
struct ContextPage
  ReadingOutcome outcome
  std::vector<ContextEntry> contexts
  std::string reason
struct KindField
  std::string name
  FieldRole role
struct Kind
  std::string name
  std::string title
  Raw schema
  std::vector<KindField> fields
struct Entity
  std::string id
  std::string kind
  std::string label
  std::string parent
  Raw properties
struct Collection
  std::string parent
  std::string kind
  std::vector<std::string> ids
struct Selection
  std::string view
  std::vector<std::string> entities
  std::string focus
struct ContextSnapshot
  ReadingOutcome outcome
  ContextRef context
  std::string revision
  std::vector<Entity> entities
  std::vector<Collection> collections
  std::vector<Selection> selections
  std::string cursor
  std::string reason
struct ReadRequest
  ContextRef context
  std::vector<std::string> entities
  std::string cursor
  std::int64_t limit
struct Change
  std::string base_revision
  std::string revision
  Raw patch
struct ChangesRequest
  ContextRef context
  std::string after_revision
  std::int64_t wait_ms
struct ChangeBatch
  ReadingOutcome outcome
  ContextRef context
  std::vector<Change> changes
  std::string revision
  std::string reason
struct CommandSpec
  std::string name
  std::string title
  std::string description
  CommandClass class_
  Raw input_schema
  Raw output_schema
  std::vector<std::string> targets
  bool proposable
  bool undoable
  bool idempotent
  bool long_running
struct ContextBounds
  std::int64_t snapshot_bytes
  std::int64_t change_bytes
  std::int64_t retained_revisions
  std::int64_t pending_proposals
  std::int64_t calls_in_flight
struct Description
  std::string version
  std::vector<Kind> kinds
  std::vector<CommandSpec> commands
  std::vector<std::string> extensions
  ContextBounds bounds
struct DescriptionResult
  ReadingOutcome outcome
  std::optional<Description> description
  std::string reason
struct Invocation
  ContextRef context
  Raw arguments
  InvokeMode mode
  std::string expected_revision
  std::string idempotency_key
  std::string proposal
struct CommandResult
  CommandOutcome outcome
  std::string reason
  std::string revision
  std::string proposal
  std::string summary
  std::string job
  Raw effects
  std::string undo_group
  std::string idempotency_key
struct Reveal
  ContextRef context
  std::vector<std::string> entities
  std::string style
struct UndoRequest
  ContextRef context
  std::string undo_group
  std::string expected_revision
  std::string idempotency_key
struct JobRequest
  std::string instance
  std::string job
struct DeclaredCommand
  std::string name
  CommandClass class_
struct CommandDeclaration
  std::string version
  std::vector<DeclaredCommand> commands
struct ApplicationsQuery
  std::string application
struct OpenHandleQuery
  std::string open_handle
  std::string application
struct ListedInstance
  std::string instance
  std::string interface
  std::vector<ContextEntry> contexts
  std::string reason
struct ListedApplication
  std::string application
  std::string title
  std::vector<ListedInstance> instances
struct ListedOpenVerb
  std::string name
  std::string description
  Raw input_schema
struct ApplicationOpenVerbs
  std::string application
  std::vector<ListedOpenVerb> verbs
struct OpenHandle
  std::string handle
  std::string application
  std::string state
  std::string instance
  std::string reason
struct ApplicationListing
  ReadingOutcome outcome
  std::vector<ListedApplication> applications
  std::string reason
  std::vector<ApplicationOpenVerbs> open_verbs
  std::optional<OpenHandle> open
struct CommandsQuery
  std::string application
  std::string instance
struct CommandListing
  ReadingOutcome outcome
  std::string application
  std::string instance
  std::vector<CommandSpec> commands
  std::string reason
struct GatewayCall
  std::string application
  std::string instance
  std::string tool
  Raw arguments
  std::optional<InvokeMode> mode
  std::string expected_revision
  std::string idempotency_key
  std::string context
  std::string proposal
  std::optional<bool> require_read_permit
struct CallRecord
  std::string subject
  std::string client_label
  std::string application
  std::string instance
  std::optional<ContextRef> context
  std::string command
  std::optional<CommandClass> class_
  std::string revision_before
  std::string revision_after
  std::string outcome
  std::string reason
  std::string idempotency_key
  std::string arguments_digest
  std::string result_digest
struct Envelope
  std::optional<DescriptionResult> description
  std::optional<ContextPage> contexts
  std::optional<ReadRequest> read
  std::optional<ContextSnapshot> snapshot
  std::optional<ChangesRequest> changes_request
  std::optional<ChangeBatch> changes
  std::optional<Invocation> invocation
  std::optional<CommandResult> result
  std::optional<Reveal> reveal
  std::optional<UndoRequest> undo
  std::optional<JobRequest> job
  std::optional<CommandDeclaration> declaration
  std::optional<CallRecord> record
  std::optional<ApplicationsQuery> applications_query
  std::optional<ApplicationListing> applications
  std::optional<CommandsQuery> commands_query
  std::optional<CommandListing> commands
  std::optional<GatewayCall> call
inline std::string encode(const Envelope& v)
inline Envelope decode(std::string_view data)
